summary: You have produced a strong, well-structured preliminary report. Your mission concept is clear, with four quantified objectives and named users whose needs are traced to those objectives. Your Gantt-based plan, with a risk and contingency table, and your orbit calculations, which expose a real coverage trade-off, show good technical progress. Remaining gaps are the missing launch analysis, an unjustified sensor assumption, and one misattributed area figure.
next_steps: Correct the 344,400 km² figure so it is attributed to the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park rather than the reef itself, or reword it.
Justify the 6,000-pixel across-track count by linking it to a named detector or sensor specification, and state the source.
Add a preliminary launch analysis covering candidate launch vehicles and the resulting trajectory, so the work meets the launch requirement (R2) as well as the orbit analysis.

criteria.C1: You set out a clear goal, four quantified objectives, and named users (GBRMPA, CSIRO/universities, BoM), with needs explicitly linked to objectives, and your referencing is strong. To reach the top band, quantitatively justify the objectives and correct the reef area figure, which is the Marine Park area rather than the reef's area.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt chart, task descriptions, logical dependency ordering, and risk table with triggers and responses make the plan robust, and you explain why the plan follows the mission narrative (for example, orbit work before ground control). To reach the top band, add a little more detail on launch-stage milestones.
criteria.C3: Your hand calculations for period, orbits per day, inclination, ground-track shift and swath are correct and checked against STK, and you interpret them well. To strengthen this, show progress on the launch stage and justify the sensor pixel assumption.
criteria.C4: Your report has a logical headed structure, labelled figures and tables, and all 11 references are cited in text and listed. To improve, replace the weak source [11] with a more authoritative reference and make the Gantt deadline markers clearly visible.
